At Gulf Coast Veterinary Specialists (GCVS), we’ve been a trusted leader in veterinary specialty and emergency care since 1988. Our Houston hospital is one of the nation’s largest specialty hospitals, with a team of more than 70 board-certified specialists and 350+ dedicated support staff are united in delivering exceptional care for pets and peace of mind for their families.

In the fall of 2025, we expanded to a second location in Webster, TX, to meet the growing demand for specialized and emergency veterinary care in the area.
